_comment: Shared TS<->Python parity fixture for availability-aware role resolution (spec internal/spec-model-rungs-and-roles-2026-06-09.md Addendum 3.A). Both ModelRouter.ts (resolveRoleAvailability) and primary_bot.py (resolve_role_with_availability) must resolve each (pod, bot, credentialed) triple to the SAME {model, resolvedRole, degraded, reason} per role. 'credentialed' is the RAW provider set (presence of a usable key); availability intersects it against the LLM-capable set DERIVED from the merged catalog's rung clusters (no provider literal — three-homes rule Addendum 3.B). 'reason' unifies degradation: uncredentialed | unconfigured | null. The former judge role (and its same_vendor_as_standard advisory reason) was collapsed — J3, internal/design-judge-role-collapse-2026-08-21.md 5.4. 'expectCrossVendor' pins the cross-vendor derivation (design 5.2 — resolve_cross_vendor / resolveCrossVendor): per against-role, the first credentialed model in the resolved role's rung whose provider differs from the resolved model's, or null when none exists (null is meaningful — a single-provider pod gets no cross-vendor judge). KEEP IN SYNC: edit once; both parity tests read it.

scenarios.name: fully credentialed pod — every role resolves, no degradation
non-LLM credential only (brave) — every LLM role unavailable
scenarios._comment: brave is credentialed but is NOT in any rung cluster, so the LLM-capable intersection is empty. Every role degrades to the bottom of the ladder and still finds nothing -> unavailable with uncredentialed.

scenarios.name: only openai credentialed — max degrades down to a credentialed rung
scenarios._comment: fable-class is anthropic-only in defaults, but the enriched opus-class now holds openai/gpt-4.1 (Addendum 7 #13). With only openai credentialed: max degrades max->power; power's opus-class holds openai/gpt-4.1 so max resolves there (resolvedRole=power, degraded, uncredentialed). power itself resolves WITHIN its own opus-class rung to openai/gpt-4.1 (no degradation). standard resolves to openai/gpt-4.1 within sonnet-class. fast resolves to openai/gpt-4.1-mini within haiku-class. expectCrossVendor is null everywhere — a single-provider pod gets no cross-vendor option (the meaningful null, design 5.2).

scenarios.name: within-rung credentialed fallback preferred over degradation
scenarios._comment: pod gives power's opus-class a two-provider cluster [anthropic, openai]; only openai credentialed. power resolves WITHIN its own rung to the openai member (no degradation) rather than degrading to standard.

scenarios.name: anthropic-only pod — every role resolves to anthropic; no cross-vendor option
scenarios._comment: The single-provider live shape. Every ladder role resolves on anthropic; expectCrossVendor is null (the meaningful null — design 5.2/5.3: the call site decides, e.g. SessionStruggleJudge falls back to classifierModel flagged cross_vendor:false). The second-provider recommendation on AI Optimization is the surface that nudges this pod toward failover + cross-vendor checking.
